images.caption:
British Ships of the First World War
HMS QUEEN MARY. In action at Heligoland Bight, 1914. Destroyed at Jutland when her forward magazines exploded after hits by 12-inch shells from DERFFLINGER. 1266 men were lost.

images.caption: Composite from 2 photos taken from HMS Lydiard of the 9th destroyer flotilla. Right photo HMS Queen Mary blowing up at the Battle of Jutland 1916.
